messages:
customer-rep: FYI customer (acme-payments) reporting corrupted JSON from our JSON mode when kv-cache + batching are enabled. Happening on /v1/generate streaming. Escalating.
maria: Can you paste the exact request/response and repro steps? Are they on Dedicated or Hosted?
customer-rep: Hosted. Minimal repro: concurrent checkout webhook enrichment calls (~8 concurrent) to the same route. Request payload example:
```
POST /v1/generate
{
  "model": "gpt-4o-redwood",
  "json_mode": "best_effort",
  "kv_cache": "enabled",
  "batching": "auto",
  "prompt": "{\"invoice_id\": 1234, \"items\": [...] }"
}
```
Partial streaming chunks they captured (simplified):
```
data: {"id":"tok1","object":"chunk","text":"{\"invoice_id\": 1234, \"amount\": 100"}
data: {"id":"tok2","object":"chunk","text":"", \"items\": [ {\"sku\":\"A1\",\"qty\":1} ] }
```
When the client stitches the chunks they get: `{"invoice_id": 1234, "amount": 100", "items": [ {"sku":"A1","qty":1} ] }` (note stray quote) — sometimes the pieces include fragments from other concurrent requests, resulting in mixed fields.
jen: This looks like cross-request interleaving at the streaming/batching boundary + kvcache prefix reuse. Can you confirm if the route has prefix caching enabled (we saw some older routes with `prefix_cache: true`).
customer-rep: Confirmed prefix_cache = true on that route. Happens intermittently after spikes. Customer reproduced locally by firing 20 concurrent requests with small prompts.
alex: Short-term mitigation: disable prefix/kvcache for that route or set `json_mode: strict` so the runtime will validate/close malformed JSON before emitting. Both will increase latency/cost but prevent corruption.
henry: We already have a patch in staging that tags KV cache entries with a request/session tag so entries can't be mixed across concurrent batches. Plan: canary that change, then rollout. For immediate relief we can flip a host-level flag to disable batching for this route or inject header `X-RW-disable-kvcache: 1` from the customer proxy.
customer-rep: Do we have a reproducible test harness we can give the customer (so they can validate once we patch)?
jen: Yes — create a quick loadtest script: 8 concurrent streaming requests that parse chunks and assert valid JSON at the end. I pushed an example to the repo in `tools/repro/kvcache-json-interleave.sh` (internal). Steps:
1) Set `json_mode=best_effort` & `kv_cache=enabled`
2) Run the script with --concurrency 8 --rate 50
3) Check failures where `json.loads` fails or final string contains duplicate fields.
alex: Also advised customer to switch to non-streaming for critical billing invoices until we confirm fix (they agreed temporarily).
deploy-bot: :rocket: canary deploy started: kvcache-tagging-v2 -> us-west-2 (5 hosts)
maria: Created ticket ESCL-4532, linked logs and customer's request id. Owner: henry. ETA: hotfix canary complete in ~3h, prod roll in 24h if canary looks good. Assigned follow-ups: add route-level warning for prefix_cache + json_mode combos, and add an automatic test to our CI that simulates streaming interleave. I will update the customer with the workaround and ETA. :thumbsup:
